scope: Transactional canonical import attempt history and owned migration recovery
verified_cases: Import creation, claim, failure and staged page recorded in the same transaction
History begins before child binding without a binding/source race
Concurrent failure and stage replays record one event each
A successful retry does not erase the earlier failure
Transaction rollback removes source mutation and event together
Per-child sequence provides bounded owner history independent of clock ties
No raw lease token, provider payload or credential stored in events
Current progress separates attempt counters from record observations
Existing pretracking run gets one baseline without changing its lease, cursor or error
Earlier history is not inferred from a migration baseline
Private table and owner/inactive/anonymous/service HTTP denial
Populated event history survives full database and physical Storage restore
limitations: Clinical/capture reconciliation, item drill-down, resolution records and frozen reports remain pending
Import core authorization after source-gate waits needs independent reproduction and review
No provider, clinician or cutover acceptance claimed
